column1: # Experimental checkpoint: facfedf15. Accepted production checkpoint: eb5d4c580.
# Production retains allocation-free augmenting-path assignment commits and reconstructs the term-consumed Bag with the final assignment scan. The rejected treatment is preserved at facfedf15.
# Host: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 5975WX, 32 physical cores, one thread per core; CPU 8 pinned; frequency boost enabled.

# Command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0 taskset -c 8 cargo bench -p rholang --bench spatial_matcher_remainder --features rspace-reservation-delta-differential -- --noplot
# Fixture: 16, 256, or 4,096 unordered Send targets; one exact selected Send; one free Par remainder. Fixture cloning and output validation were outside the timed interval.
# Arms: control_final_assignment_scan is the exact predecessor. treatment_committed_bag_delta updates normalized PathMap BagDelta occupancy only while unwinding a proven-successful augmenting root.
# Criterion: one shot; 82 post-warm-up samples per arm/cell; 2 s warm-up; 5 s requested measurement; 99% confidence; 1% significance; no competing Cargo or rustc process at launch.
# Pgmcp experiment 246: REJECTED. Primary 4,096-target Welch t=-1.3004161478, one-sided p=0.0977577644, Cohen's d=-0.2030908818, treatment-minus-control 95% CI [-751450.3234,155020.9576] ns.
# Robustness: both arms depart from normality; Mann-Whitney p=0.4347523821 and Cliff's delta=-0.0707911957 agree that the observed primary difference is not persuasive.

# Operational criterion also failed: the treatment improved the 4,096-target mean by only 0.368526%, below the preregistered 5% threshold. The 16-target regression was 2.139636%, within the 5% small-cell guardrail; 256 improved 1.269048%.

# Pgmcp artifact 324 preserves the one-shot console report. Semantic preflight: 14/14, including all 651 bounded oracle cases and a displacement path with three additions, one normalized removal, and final cardinality two. Accepted-state postflight: 13/13 plus strict production-library Clippy.
